package_info.package_name: imageless malicious Docker Hub repository (Downloader, eBook Phishing, Website SEO campaigns)
package_info.package_versions: N/A (repository-based, not versioned like code packages)
package_info.why_malicious: These repositories are intentionally created without container images but with malicious metadata designed to lure users into phishing scams or to distribute malware. The campaigns exploit Docker Hub's trust and searchability to spread harmful content at scale, often using automation to create millions of repositories.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Malicious metadata in repository README or description, e.g., links to phishing sites or malware downloads.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: When a user browses or searches Docker Hub and views the repository, the metadata presents links or instructions that direct the user to external phishing or malware sites, leading to credential theft or malware infection.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Legitimate Docker Hub repositories are expected to contain valid container images and documentation relevant to the software. Repositories with no images but with external links or download instructions are highly suspicious.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal repositories provide container images and technical documentation; these repositories provide only metadata with malicious links and no actual software.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate repositories may provide external documentation links, but not as the sole content, and not to unrelated or suspicious domains.
key_indicators: README or description contains external links to unrelated or suspicious domains
Repository created in large automated batches

attack_chain.action: Automated creation of millions of imageless repositories with malicious metadata (links to phishing/malware sites).
attack_chain.leads_to: User discovery of repository via search or browsing.

attack_chain.action: User views repository and is enticed by metadata to click on external links.
attack_chain.leads_to: User is redirected to phishing or malware site.

attack_chain.action: Phishing or malware site attempts to steal credentials or infect the user's system.

behavioral_signatures: Repositories with no container images but with populated README or description fields containing external links
Large-scale automated creation of repositories by a single user or small set of users
Repository metadata containing keywords related to downloads, giveaways, or unrelated offers
file_indicators: README or description fields containing URLs to non-Docker domains
network_indicators: Links in metadata pointing to known phishing or malware domains
Unusual outbound traffic from Docker Hub users to suspicious external sites after repository browsing
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor Docker Hub for repositories with no images but with non-empty README or description fields containing external URLs, especially those created in large batches or associated with known malicious campaigns. Flag repositories with metadata linking to known phishing or malware domains. Alert on user activity that follows links from such repositories to external sites.
